study.question: Does the signed component of the buy-to-context cotangent parallel to its context/history product route preserve click validation quality without the perpendicular component, and does any effect require restoration of per-field magnitude?
study.hypothesis: Observation: r0075 native click AUC=0.6685318110053072, perpendicular reflection=0.6684957032668137 (delta -0.0000361077384935), parallel reflection=0.6678734802477688 (delta -0.0006583307575384), both reversed=0.6679515669958391. This asymmetry suggests, but does not establish, that the signed parallel component is more consequential than the perpendicular component. Let R and P be buy residual-adapter and product-route VJPs to the concatenated context, N=R+P. For each field with product unit axis u, A=<N,u>u, T=N-A. Hypothesis: retaining A alone can preserve more click quality than retaining T alone at matched native field norm; the raw/restored factorial tests whether apparent sufficiency is caused by magnitude. These are first-order training surrogates with identical inference operators, not gradients of a new objective.

nearest_work.difference: Exact frozen local parent, source SHA256 333ad461198581c68f0efab4a78797b05db0feb40466f4300e3d317dba012d50. Retain its split context graph, all learned modules and summary intervention. Replace sign reflections by component deletion crossed with component/native field norm.

That receipt uses product direction with native total field allocation and scored 0.6683008219171853. A here retains the sign of the total cotangent projection onto P, rather than always using positive P; T is separately tested. The r0074 ancestor source is unavailable in this workspace, so only receipt/config provenance is checked.

Archived primary text read, especially lines250-283: target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and weighted pooling are inherited through the local adaptation. This is not exact DIN reproduction and the proposed difference is a buy-specific backward intervention, not a claim of new attention or compression.

Pinned benchmark implementation inspected, constructor and forward lines123-170: task-specific masked sequence hubs and categorical/task token exchange differ from this inherited moment compression and fixed forward. No hubs or repeated broadcasts adopted; inspection does not establish equivalence to the original INFNet paper.

study.proposed_difference: Cross retained component {signed parallel A, perpendicular T} with magnitude {raw component, native per-field norm}. Compute scaled FP32 geometry to avoid squaring raw magnitudes. Shared admissible support: nonzero P and N, and both ||A_scaled|| and ||T_scaled|| exceed 1e-6*||N_scaled||. All four arms return exact native N outside support, so zero/near-collinear/near-orthogonal fields do not identify component sufficiency. On support, raw arms return the component; restored arms return unit(component)*||N_f||. No borrowing of a vanished component and no unbounded norm ratio. Same support, calculations and inference in every cell. Native mode remains available for host parity checks but is not a fifth training variant.
predictions: Directional prediction: parallel_restored click AUC exceeds orthogonal_restored by at least 0.0001. This is a prospective practical screening margin, not a significance threshold.

Provisional sufficiency prediction: parallel_restored is no more than 0.0001 below archived native AUC0.6685318110053072. A larger improvement would remain exploratory until authorized independent repetition.

Raw versus restored simple effects and their difference-in-differences distinguish component deletion from magnitude restoration. No sign is assumed for this interaction; a benefit only under restoration supports a magnitude-dependent surrogate rather than raw component sufficiency.

Parameter counts are expected to remain 32192421 total /31793216 embedding /399205 dense. Evaluation operator and model-only latency should remain comparable; measured training cost, memory and throughput must be reported, not presumed equal.
All four task AUC/logloss and existing history slices are retained. Buy and auxiliary degradation can coexist with click gains; auxiliary mean is not the selection metric.
falsifiers: parallel_restored failing to exceed orthogonal_restored by the predeclared practical margin rejects the proposed directional prediction for this implementation; it does not refute the entire mechanism class.
parallel_restored more than0.0001 below native rejects practical sufficiency. If both projections lose quality, native mixture may be needed even though sign reflections were asymmetric.
If only restored A preserves native quality, raw A sufficiency is falsified; attribute the result to a direction/magnitude interaction until further controls.
If common support is negligible or numerical parity/ownership checks fail, mark the contrast non-identifying or implementation-invalid rather than a scientific refutation.

A validation advantage explained by added measured cost, repeated-validation selection or untested seed variation does not establish a justified quality-cost improvement or repeated mechanism support.
alternative_explanations: One seed and adaptive validation reuse across 276 successful archived trials; same-seed replay is not an independent replication
Per-example field norms before dtype cast do not match repeated-ID sparse sums, task-summed gradients, Adagrad updates, dense global clipping or subsequent trajectories
Restoration changes component magnitude; raw arms identify this interaction but do not equalize optimizer trajectories
Common support gate may exclude many fields; absent host coverage diagnostics, support prevalence is unknown
Projection geometry uses local buy branch cotangents, not a dot product with click loss; it cannot establish cross-task gradient agreement
r0075 orthogonal reflection may preserve performance through cancellation, regularization or irrelevant fields; tolerance to reversing T does not imply tolerance to deleting T
Auxiliary summary updates can influence later context cotangents and dense clipping despite detached auxiliary history inputs; r0071 context isolation equality does not isolate those temporal paths
Auxiliary labels refer to same user/category/brand within24h, not direct target-ad conversions; released offline historical feedback maturity is not established

evidence_review.status: Prospective proposal only. No new training, numerical tensor checks or validation outcomes measured in this phase.
evidence_review.trajectory_review: Reviewed276 authorized trajectory summaries: all status success, so no execution failures are present in this delivered index; this is not evidence that unprovided failures never occurred. Scientific negatives include unanchored compressed task model0.6591942 versus source0.6606469, while target-match detail task0.6630190 improved over early matched alternatives. Later nonlinear block placement0.6685269 improved the fixed-seed path, whereas added retrieval, event placement and altered activations did not exceed it. r0071 restored/native context-isolated runs both0.6680376118468522; r0072 single-route and r0073-74 direction/allocation controls remained below native. Preserve these unsuccessful branches; one failed implementation is not mechanism refutation.
evidence_review.knowledge_usage_review: Read latest_knowledge_usage alongside measured r0075 outcomes. INFNet, HiFormer, Zenith, TokenMixer, EST and SSR were declared considered, with no executed architectural adoption; paper:tokenformer remained unresolved. Current reflection outcomes do not validate those external architectures. Only DIN primary text and pinned INFNet benchmark source were newly inspected here. Registry search for gradient projection multitask returned no primary match; nearest-work coverage for gradient surgery is incomplete and originality remains unverified.

host_validation_plan: Before training: enforce matching protocol/data/source identities and same host runtime checks. Verify exact parameter/buffer names, shapes, counts, initialization and RNG state against archived native source with identical frozen config. Reject on mismatch; retain charged failure receipt.

Fixed-state forward parity: all four cells versus native in train/eval, and after a step. Compare logits/probabilities and Dice running buffers. Compare native mode context VJP to R+P. Different learned trajectories after steps are expected; only compare same copied state.

Independent tensor VJP fixtures, full field width16 and multiple fields: P=(1,0,...), R=(1,3,0,...), so N=(2,3,...), A=(2,0,...), T=(0,3,...); raw outputs equal these, restored outputs (sqrt13,0,...) or (0,sqrt13,...). Negative projection fixture P=(1,0,...),R=(-3,4,...): A=(-2,0,...), retain negative sign. Compare with independent float64 orthogonal projection reference, not finite-difference gradcheck of the intentionally surrogate derivative.

Test zero R/P/N, exact cancellation, collinear/orthogonal and near-degenerate fields, noncontiguous contexts, missing one or both output cotangents and scales1e-30/1e30. Common-support failures must return exact native VJP in all cells; all-zero remains zero. On admitted fields check A+T=N, orthogonality, retained direction and native per-field norms for restored modes in FP32 before cast. Test BF16/host autocast with dtype-appropriate tolerances and finite outputs/gradients. No higher-order derivative claim.

Verify only the buy-to-context cotangent changes: identical fixed-state task-parameter gradients, unchanged other task VJPs, detached auxiliary item/action/scorer/tower-context paths, and all learned parameters still in the loss graph. Test normal label order and permuted label order using label identities.

Masking/input checks: empty, partial, full and noncontiguous histories; perturb padded historical item/action IDs only, preserving targets and masks, and require invariant predictions. Target action never enters forward. Verify all four finite [B,1] predictions and finite default BCE backward.

If authorized host diagnostics support it, record common support fraction and component/native norm ratios by field, with counts and zero/degenerate reasons; use temporary diagnostic copies/hooks, no persistent model state or additional data. Otherwise explicitly report unavailable and keep mechanism attribution limited.

Execute only the four frozen full-protocol training/validation jobs through the host proposal consumer; account wall/GPU seconds, examples, peak memory, parameters, throughput and p50/p95 latency. No coding-jail torch installation/training, no new seeds, no test feedback. Report standard per-task scores and history slices with samples/positives/negatives; other requested slices/cluster bootstrap only if exposed by the authorized evaluator, otherwise unavailable.
